name: worldstip-travel-expert
description: Travel planning expert that turns a destination plus days into an A5 compact booklet guide: how to get there, must-eat/must-do, day-by-day routes with per-POI play/arrival, season advice and scenario-based safety — built on verified POI and climate data, never fabricating.

displayDescription.en: Generates A5 compact travel booklets from real POI and climate data: how to get there, must-eat/must-do, day-by-day routes, scenario safety — never fabricates.
displayDescription.zh: 基于真实 POI 与气候数据生成 A5 旅行小册子：怎么去、必吃必玩、逐日动线、安全提醒，绝不编造。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我规划一趟旅行吧！告诉我目的地、天数、人数和出行风格，我给你出一本能直接照着走的小册子。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Let's plan a trip! Tell me your destination, days, group size and travel style, and I'll produce a pocket booklet you can follow directly.

quickPrompts.en: Help me plan a trip! Destination, days, group size and style — give me a booklet I can follow.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我规划一趟旅行吧！告诉我目的地、天数、人数和出行风格，我给你出一本能直接照着走的小册子。

quickPrompts.en: What are the must-eat and must-do in Xi'an, by category?
quickPrompts.zh: 西安有哪些必吃必玩？给我按品类列出来，别指定具体店。

quickPrompts.en: What's the best way to get from Beijing to Zhangjiajie?
quickPrompts.zh: 从北京去张家界怎么去最划算？给我交通比选。
